t: What's the Best Thing to Buy for a Better Quality of Life? → Question
s: September 11, 2025 - In a world that has professionalized and outsourced nearly every aspect of daily life, from growing food to mending clothes to even entertaining ourselves, we have become passive consumers of our own existence. This passivity is profoundly detrimental to our well-being. The best thing to buy, then, is not an object that performs a function for you, but the tool and the knowledge that allow you to perform that function yourself. It is the sewing machine and the course to learn how to use it; the set of quality kitchen knives and the cooking class; the woodworking tools and the apprenticeship.
